alternatives.reason_rejected: Same untracked-suppression behaviour measured by the field-register reviewer

context: Docs batch for field #3/#4 written and review-fixed: Doc 4 response, UPGRADE-v2 multi-host + merging sections, README paragraph, FOUNDATION-PLAN D2/D5 annotations, Doc 2 errata; 3-lens read-only review applied
rationale: EXECUTED on git 2.50.1 (two reviewers independently, then reproduced here): with a bare wildcard exclude `git add` stages only already-tracked modified files and silently skips EVERY untracked file under the positive pathspec, exit 0 — so a drain built on it would commit mutations but never a newly created record, forever, while reporting success. The anchored form staged new + modified records at every depth and excluded .tmp siblings at every depth. Applied to Doc 4 §2.4, UPGRADE-v2, and the plan.
summary: The drain recipe's *.tmp exclude is anchored to the directory (`:(exclude).twining/records/*.tmp`), never a bare `:(exclude)*.tmp`
